title: Towards Multi-Stakeholder Evaluation of ML Models: A Crowdsourcing Study on Metric Preferences in Job-matching System
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating stakeholder preferences for fairness metrics (such as Disparate Impact and Equalized Odds) in machine learning. Fairness and the mitigation of systemic bias are core components of AI ethics, and the study investigates how individuals weigh these ethical metrics against performance metrics.
